scope: Initial reference model; GPU, CPU and storage variants need separate validation.
known_blockers: AMDGPU video playback crashes and framebuffer allocation failures remain unresolved on the measured 7.3 system.
Final 7.3 rebuild has artifact checks but no installed boot validation.
Requested CachyOS 7.2.7-1 port has not been built.
BCM4360 requires exact-kernel precompiled proprietary wl; static linking remains unproven.

evidence.claim: One MacPro6,1 booted an earlier 7.3 slim kernel without initramfs.
evidence.limit: Not universal model, variant, performance or long-term stability proof.

default_security_policy: Keep distribution defaults. No automatic mitigations=off or signature bypass.
initramfs_free: candidate-only; independently verify direct root topology, built-in dependencies and early firmware
